CustomField.description: Denormalised copy of the Box for Salesforce folder association for this loan's governed folder. Read as a fallback when box__FRUP__c is unavailable to the caller, so losing the association lookup does not cost the answer.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Box folder ID of the loan file. Normally set from the Box for Salesforce association; edit only when that association is missing.
